description:
Capture a snapshot and PRESENT it inline in the chat for the user to see. Returns the same base64 JPEG as `snapshot`, but in MCP Apps hosts (e.g. Claude Desktop) it also renders as a full inline preview with fit-to-width and zoom — no need to expand the tool accordion.

Use this ONLY when the user asked to see a result, or when showing a finished result is genuinely useful to them. For your own iterative verification ('did the layout change', 'is the block where I dropped it'), use `snapshot` / `snapshot_object` instead — those stay collapsed and won't clutter the chat.

Targets mirror the other snapshot tools: a page/spread (with optional `region` zoom-box), or a single object by `pageItemId`. Pass `pageItemId` to present one object; otherwise pass `target` + `index`.

description.description:
Brief description shown in the InDesign plugin panel. REQUIRED FORMAT:

Line 1: What Sidekick is doing (present progressive tense, e.g., 'Showing page 1')

Line 2: Manual alternative (e.g., 'You can also use **File > Export** (`Cmd+E`)')

ALWAYS include the manual alternative on line 2. Supports markdown: **bold**, `code`.

index.description: Zero-based index of the page or spread to capture (required with `target`).

isolate.description: With `pageItemId`: render only the object itself, stripping overlapping content.

pageItemId.description: Present a single page item by id (from get_layout with includeItems). When set, `target`/`index`/`region` are ignored.

preview.description: Set true for a low-resolution preview. Ignored with `region` or `pageItemId`.

region.description: Optional zoom-box [x0,y0,x1,y1] in normalized 0..1 page coordinates (top-left origin). Only valid with target 'page'.

target.description: Capture a single page or an entire spread. Omit when presenting an object.

name: show_snapshot
